description: The Telangana government plans to use AI to determine insurance payouts for farmers under the Rythu Bima scheme. This aims to provide precise crop dam
body_lead: HYDERABAD: The state govt is considering using artificial intelligence to determine the insurance amount to be paid to farmers under Rythu Bima scheme and to ensure precision in crop damage. If AI is introduced to quantify crop damage, Telangana will be the second state in India to do so after Madhya Pradesh, official sources said. A team of senior officials is expected to visit that state soon to gain first-hand knowledge on how the scheme is implemented there leveraging AI.
